intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Union Properties PJSC ("we", "us", or "Union Properties") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our MIRDAD project website or express interest in our properties.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when you:
items: Register your interest in MIRDAD residences
Request a brochure or floor plans
Schedule a viewing or consultation
Subscribe to our newsletter
Contact us via phone, email, or WhatsApp
collection.dataTypes: This information may include your name, email address, phone number, country of residence, preferred unit type, and any messages or preferences you share with us.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use the information we collect to:
items: Respond to your inquiries about MIRDAD properties
Send you requested brochures and property information
Provide personalized property recommendations
Schedule viewings and consultations
Send marketing communications (with your consent)
Improve our website and services

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.content: We may share your information with:
items: Our authorized sales agents and representatives
Service providers who assist in our operations
Legal authorities when required by law
sharing.noSale: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes encryption, secure servers, and regular security assessments.

rights.title: Your Rights
items: Access the personal information we hold about you
Request correction of inaccurate information
Request deletion of your information
Withdraw consent for marketing communications
Lodge a complaint with relevant authorities

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze website traffic. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For any privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, please contact us:
contact.address: Address: Union Properties PJSC, Motor City, Dubai, UAE
